task_name: Classify land cover from Sentinel-2 training samples
task_description: The retained core workflow filters Sentinel-2 imagery by region, date, and metadata, selects spectral bands, mosaics and averages the image collection, builds training sample regions, trains a Random Forest land-cover classifier, and applies it to generate classified land-cover rasters.
original_task_description: The script classifies land cover into five distinct classes—water, high vegetation, exposed soil, low vegetation, and roads—using Sentinel-2 imagery. It computes spectral indices (NDVI, EVI, NDBI), trains a Random Forest classifier on labeled sample regions, validates model accuracy with confusion matrices, and generates a classified land cover map clipped to a user-defined geometry (ZO_ZC).
known_omissions: ["external feature collections and labeled sample provenance are source context", "confusion matrices and accuracy metrics", "Map display, print output, and display/export noise"]
